presets.name: Meshtastic 2.8.3.7aba92f · Heltec V4 R8 TFT · 30 dBm + narrow freq fix
presets.description: Unofficial build: EU power limit raised to 30 dBm, plus meshtastic/firmware#11559 and meshtastic/device-ui#502 (correct displayed frequency on narrow presets).

install.label: Full install (erases flash)
install.description: Wipes the device, including settings and keys.

update.label: Update (keeps settings)
update.description: Writes only the app to 0x10000. The device must already run Meshtastic 2.8 with the 16MB partition layout.
